meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero on his phone, in class, and nobody called me.
Hale, I'm here to ask who decided on the zero, and when.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered no evidence and no ownership of how the zero was entered.
What cost ground: You answered her question about who decided the zero with a courtesy, which left her with no reason to give anything up.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed nothing, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her and that was wrong, then put a dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
